prompt: Complete a static paint method that draws full-height vertical stripes of equal width, alternating black and white starting with black. Follow the formulas in the starter Javadoc exactly.
explanation: One loop draws every stripe: the index gives both the position (i * stripeWidth) and the color (i % 2 picks black for even, white for odd). Each fillRect spans the full height, so the stripes tile the image exactly when width is divisible by the stripe count. Choosing the color inside the loop before each fillRect is the key pattern -- Graphics2D is a state machine, and every fill uses whatever color was set most recently.
hints: Compute stripeWidth = width / stripes once, before the loop.
Use i % 2 == 0 to decide between Color.BLACK and Color.WHITE for stripe i.
Each stripe is g.fillRect(i * stripeWidth, 0, stripeWidth, height) after setting its color.
